subject: large spatial error, low sampling interval

messages.author: fd404cb3ef2d7513
messages.subject: large spatial error, low sampling interval
parts:
Hi Chris,
I have VHF telemetry data with high spatial errors, reaching several 100 m, as estimated by the razimuth package. These spatial errors exceed the distances that my animals can cover during the sampling intervals, which have a minimum duration of 2 seconds.
Should I consider resampling my data to a lower temporal resolution, or do continuous time models inherently address this issue when incorporating errors into the models?

Many thanks and best,
Markus

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: large spatial error, low sampling interval
parts:
Hi Markus,

Turning the error model on should work better than thinning the data, unless the error model is bad.

Best,
Chris
